I recommend this clinic! Attached is the picture of before and after treatment.

text:
I visited CIDC Chiang Mai for a professional teeth whitening kit, but I am very disappointed with the outcome. After 9 days of strict use with 15% Carbamide Peroxide, my lower teeth are still yellow.
The reason is a major technical flaw: the lower tray they provided is too loose and not properly custom-fitted. Despite following all instructions (storing gel in the fridge, drying teeth perfectly, and wearing them overnight), saliva leaks into the tray immediately, diluting the gel and making the treatment completely ineffective. Even the results on the upper teeth are underwhelming for a professional service. I’m really disappointed.

text:

The fear is totally irrational, I know.  So, based on a string of 5-star reviews heaped on CIDC, I made an appointment for deep cleaning and a couple of fillings.

That day, I saw Dr. Thanyalak, and she explained to me in fluent English as to what the dental procedure would entail.  Gentle solo piano music played in the background, and my anxiety eased under the very capable hands of the doctor deftly doing the work.  The whole experience was quite pleasant really.

Kudos to Dr. Thanyalak for her warmth, empathy, and professionalism!  And to the receptionists who cheerfully accommodated my busy traveling schedule!
